title: secp256k1-ecdlp: bounded 32-adding rho with explicit heuristic

claims.statement: For ONLY secp256k1-ecdlp, the bounded 32-adding Pollard rho algorithm and track reduction in proof.md have success probability at least 0.39 under the explicitly stated and supported random-walk heuristic H. Total computation is bounded by 2^166 target-operation equivalents under classical-group-work-v2 at the protected scoring parameters (C=1000), including every attempt, preprocessing and verification. The claim is heuristic in runtime success, not unconditional; output checks and the instruction cap are unconditional. Memory, zero advice, preprocessing and, where applicable, W(n) are specified in proof.md. No practical production solve is claimed.

experiments.purpose: Check invariant, collision recovery and bounded restarts on four toy prime-order groups. Does not certify production mixing or instruction counts.
